F2 (DE sign-ins) is only LIKELY and corroborates but is not needed; the DQ vpn_session_order conflict on the appliance does not invalidate the independent confirmed sign-in evidence in F1 or the appliance exposure in F3. Nothing explains the Cloud VPS sign-ins away, so not benign; the confirmed chain exceeds monitor. Contain the account.
